title: Third-moment bound for normalized Rademacher sums
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $a_1,\ldots,a_n$ be real numbers satisfying $\sum_{i=1}^n a_i^2=1$. If $|a_i|\le\varepsilon$ for every $i$, then for independent uniform signs $X_1,\ldots,X_n$, the sum of the third absolute moments of the summands $a_iX_i$ is at most $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: The sign vector is distributed uniformly on the sign cube
